extraction.notes: No active summer camp programs or 2027 summer program announcements were found. The official Teen Programs page explicitly cancels the Young Naturalist Teen Program for summer 2026 and says, "We plan to continue the program in the future as resources allow." The Education page still advertises two summer teen volunteer opportunities, and older 2026 information PDFs remain indexed; these conflict with the cancellation notice and should not be treated as active offerings. Direct opens of the supplied pages and both PDFs returned no readable text; official search-indexed text was available. Recheck https://wildwnc.org/teen-programs/ for a future restart announcement.
